risks: R1 — Replacement seam is record-only: replacement-manifest replacement.providedFile is a schema field with NO consumer anywhere in src/ (verified by grep). Resolving an assets[assetId] requirement therefore needs new release-layer machinery that produces a NEW materialization-style artifact (or overlay) and recompiles — it must not pretend the existing seam applies bytes. Recommendation: for the synthetic fixture, design the fixture so its rendered assets are local/brand-neutral from the start (no replacement-required render surfaces), and treat replacement application for real sites as a resolution-driven NEW asset run; document whichever seam is built.

R2 — SSRF fetcher blocks loopback: a synthetic fixture cannot materialize assets from a 127.0.0.1 server without the TEST-ONLY allowPrivateHostPorts policy override (already used by smoke-assets). Use that override inside smoke-release only, never in production code paths.

R3 — Indexable gate is currently seo-plan-driven: production:compile flips to 'indexable' purely on seoPlan.domainState.mode!=='preview' and skips buildPreviewBlockers in that mode (src/production/run.ts ~line 256). The release layer must implement the spec §19 PRODUCTION_READY gate itself (all blocker requirements resolved: replacement-required render assets 0, font decision resolved, etc.) and must not let a domain alone flip a project to PRODUCTION_READY. Read run.ts before wiring.

R4 — Stripe must stay PRODUCTION_INPUTS_REQUIRED (spec §24): the canary asserts requirement COLLECTION, not resolution. Do not re-run stripe content/theme/assets/production; collection is read-only over the accepted run dirs. A stripe release:build --dry-run is safe; a real build is unnecessary and slow (and any new run must go to NEW run-id dirs if ever executed).

R5 — No hardcoded Stripe counts (spec §23, GED-B precedent): every number in requirements (182, 51, 19, 374, 64, 66, 2 fonts...) must be read from the artifacts at runtime; the Task 24 verifier grepped for literals and Task 25's verifier will too.

R6 — Fake provider micro-slots (GED-D): if the fixture content run uses the fake provider, 1-3-char slots will honestly FAIL; author the fixture generation result manually (the --result/ingestGenerationResult seam the accepted stripe run used) to keep smoke:release deterministic and green.

R7 — Long runtimes: fixture pipeline includes real next build (≈3-4s each) plus Chromium QA; keep the fixture site tiny (2-3 routes) so smoke:release stays in minutes. Existing heavyweight suites already run up to several minutes.

R8 — Historical immutability (spec rule 3): only ADD files; new outputs in NEW run-id dirs / new release-projects namespace; docs/result and data existing files untouched; recommend smoke check asserting mtimes of cited lineage dirs unchanged after a release build (pattern exists in Task 23: find -newermt).

R9 — Theme invalidation semantics: theme runs pin the content run in their manifest (contentRunDir) — a content rerun invalidates the theme run too. The dependency graph should encode content→theme edge for correctness even though spec §12 lists 'Theme 선택 → Theme run → spec → build' only.

R10 — release-project vs host coupling: fixture host and stripe host use the same data/<host>/release-projects/ convention; projectId should be deterministic (e.g. host+lineage hash prefix) so re-prepare is idempotent and never renames an existing project.
builderBriefing:
# Task 25 Builder Briefing (facts only)

## What exists
Engine pipeline complete through Task 24 (MVP PREVIEW READY — PRODUCTION INPUTS REQUIRED, audit ACCEPT). Regression baseline 16 suites / 1,671 checks / 0 failures (per-suite table + logs in docs/result/handoffs/final-regression-logs/). Spec for Task 25 is /Users/woops/projects/web-recon/prompt (read §§4-26,32-37 twice). No 'release' code exists anywhere in src/ — greenfield module.

## Accepted Stripe lineage (all frozen, read-only)
verification data/stripe.com/2026-08-17T21-23-37-542Z → observation site-observations/2026-08-17T21-23-54-037Z-augmented → site-spec site-specs/2026-08-17T21-38-01-773Z (v4) → reconstruction reconstructions/2026-08-17T21-38-04-901Z (frozen 27/27) → template recon-templates/2026-08-18T10-45-40-007Z (slot v2, routes[]=20) → content content-runs/2026-08-18T10-46-26-129Z (scope ['/'], 361 values, 64 unresolved, 66 brand-leak warnings) → theme-extraction theme-extractions/2026-08-18T12-07-22-308Z + theme-run theme-runs/2026-08-18T12-07-34-566Z (cool-neutral) → seo snapshot source-seo-snapshots/2026-08-18T19-25-49-810Z + plan production-seo-plans/2026-08-18T19-26-12-572Z (preview, 182 needs-input) → assets asset-inventories/2026-08-19T05-54-47-361Z + asset-materializations/2026-08-19T05-54-55-204Z → spec production-specs/2026-08-19T06-36-35-798Z (production-spec-v1, 5 layers pinned dir-sha256-v1, 7 blockers) → build production-builds/2026-08-19T06-36-35-798Z (package/, QA 159/159).

## Where requirements live (collect, never re-detect)
- domain: seo plan production-seo-plan.json domainState.productionDomain.status='needs-input'
- business facts: seo plan site.businessFacts.<7 facts>.status='needs-input'
- per-route SEO: seo plan report/needs-input.json {total, entries:[{location:'routes[/x].title', basis}]} — 19 uninjected routes = entries whose basis contains 'route not in content-run scope'
- assets: inventory classification.json byClassification + decisions[]; materialization replacement-manifest.json entries[].replacement.status='awaiting-input'; residual render report/network-qa.json; build report/qa.json externalRequestsByHost
- fonts: inventory font-inventory.json license[] {family,status:'license-needs-review',selfHostApproved:false} + fallbackPlan[]
- inline SVG marks: inventory manifest counts.inlineSvgEntries=374
- content: content run manifest counts.unresolvedSlots + generation-result.json unresolved[{slotKey,reason}] + report/brand-leak.json warnings[]
- consolidated: production-spec.json indexabilityGate.blockers[{id,summary,evidence}] (7 ids) — buildPreviewBlockers() in src/production/run.ts is the GED-B-fixed model of artifact-derived summaries.
